parties.respondent: The State of Jharkhand and Ors.

summary: Appointment to Class-IV posts; advertisement dated 29.07.2010 required VIII pass, cycling test, medical fitness; no interview stipulated; respondent-State conducted interview de hors advertisement; High Court directed fresh panel without interview marks; termination of improperly appointed employees upheld; preference to local candidates; age relaxation criteria; service termination valid as selection process violated terms of advertisement; no interference with termination order.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgments upheld; termination of service maintained.
